BabyBlues.0: NYUMA YO KUBYARA • UBUZIMA BWO MU MUTIMA
BabyBlues.1:
Baby blues n’ubuzima bwo mu mutima
nyuma yo kubyara
BabyBlues.2: Gusobanukirwa ivyo umutima ushobora guhinduka nyuma yo kubyara no kumenya igihe co gusaba ubufasha.
BabyBlues.8: Nyuma yo kubyara, biramenyerewe ko umutima urushiriza kworoha mu gihe. Baby blues ikunze kuba iy’igihe gito, ariko agahinda gahoraho canke kariyongera gakwiye kwitabwaho n’abaganga.
BabyBlues.14: Baby blues canke agahinda ko nyuma yo kubyara?
BabyBlues.19: Baby blues ni igihe c’impinduka zo mu mutima zishobora kuboneka mu minsi mikeya ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara. Impinduka za hormone, kunanirwa, kubura ibitiro n’ukumenyera iki gihe gishasha, vyose bishobora gutuma woroha mu mutima.
BabyBlues.20: Si ukunanirwa kandi ntibivuga ko uri umubyeyi mubi. Umuntu wese abayaho iminsi ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara mu buryo bwiwe.
BabyBlues.22: Baby blues irakunda nyuma yo kubyara kandi ikunze kugenda yonyine mu minsi mikeya.
BabyBlues.25: Ivyo abantu bahura nabwo biratandukanye. Bamwe bumva cane kunanirwa no korohera mu mutima, abandi bakaba bashobora kugira impinduka z’akamoto zigaragara cane.
BabyBlues.27: Kurira vuba canke kwumva woroshe cane mu mutima.
BabyBlues.29: Ivyiyumviro bishobora kwumvikana vyinshi kandi bigahinduka vuba.
BabyBlues.31: Kwumva woroshe bishobora gukurikirwa n’ibihe vyo kwumva umeze neza.
BabyBlues.33: Kunanirwa kwo mu minsi ya mbere kurashobora kwongera ivyiyumviro.
BabyBlues.36: Muri iki gihe, ukeneye kuruhuka cane. Ibintu bito kandi byoroshe bishobora gutuma iminsi yorohera.
BabyBlues.38: Gukoresha ibihe vyose uronse bitari ibikorwa kugira ngo woroherwe.
BabyBlues.42: Kuguma ufise amazi ahagije umusi wose.
BabyBlues.45: “Gusaba ubufasha nyuma yo kubyara ni uburyo bwo kwitwararika wewe n’umwana wawe.”
BabyBlues.47: Baby blues canke agahinda ko nyuma yo kubyara?
BabyBlues.48: Baby blues ikunze kuba iy’igihe gito kandi igenda iroroha buhorobuhoro. Agahinda ko nyuma yo kubyara kaba gatandukanye: gashobora kumara igihe kirekire, kakaba kanini kandi kagira ingaruka ikomeye ku buzima bwa buri musi.
BabyBlues.51: Akenshi iba iy’igihe gito, igenda iroroha buhorobuhoro mu minsi ikurikira.
BabyBlues.53: Gashobora kumara igihe kirekire, kakiyongera, kandi gakeneye ubufasha bw’abaganga.
BabyBlues.56: Ni vyiza kuvugana n’umuganga niba agahinda katagabanuka, kariyongera, canke gatangiye gutuma ubuzima bwa buri musi bugora.
BabyBlues.61: Biba bigoye kwitwararika wewe canke umwana wawe.
BabyBlues.64: Umubyaza, umuganga, umuhanga mu bwenge bw’umuntu canke undi muganga arashobora kugutega amatwi, agasuzuma ivyo urimwo, akaguha ubufasha bukwiye.
BabyBlues.66: Ivyiyumviro vyo nyuma yo kubyara si ibipimo vy’uko uri umubyeyi mwiza. Ufise uburenganzira bwo gukenera kuruhuka, gutegwa amatwi no gufashwa.
BabyBlues.69: Baby blues irakunda nyuma yo kubyara.
BabyBlues.70: Kunanirwa n’impinduka za hormone bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mutima.
BabyBlues.71: Ubufasha bw’abakuri hafi bushobora koroshya iki gihe.
BabyBlues.72: Agahinda gahoraho canke gakomeye gakwiye gusuzumwa n’umuganga.
BabyBlues.73: Iyi nkuru ni iyo kumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga zikureba wenyine. Niba ufise ugukeka canke wumva agahinda gakomeye, vugana n’umuganga.
BabyBlues.74: Kwitwararika ni kimwe mu bigize igihe co nyuma yo kubyara.
BabyBlues.75: Baby blues n’ubuzima bwo mu mutima nyuma yo kubyara
BabyBlues.76:
Baby blues n’ubuzima bwo mu mutima nyuma yo kubyara — AWA

Ubuyobozi bwo gusobanukirwa impinduka zo mu mutima zikunze kuboneka nyuma yo kubyara.

BabyDevelopment.1:
Ukuntu umwana wawe akura
mu nda
BabyDevelopment.6: Ukuntu umwana wawe akura, igihembwe ku kindi.
BabyDevelopment.8: Igihembwe ca mbere: iminsi ya mbere
BabyDevelopment.10: Igihembwe ca gatatu: intambwe ya nyuma
BabyDevelopment.14: Guhera mu cyumweru ca 6, umutima muto uba watanguye gutera. Mu gihembwe ca mbere, ingingo z’ingenzi zigenda ziremwa buhorobuhoro.
BabyDevelopment.16: Gutera k’umutima w’umwana ni kimwe mu bimenyetso bya mbere bigaragara kuri ultrasound, akenshi kikaba ari akanya katibagirana mu bwitwararike bwawe.
BabyDevelopment.17: Mu cyumweru ca 20 canke hafi yaco, ubusanzwe ushobora kwumva ukwimuka kwa mbere kw’umwana. Ni na ho ibiyumviro bitangura gukura.
BabyDevelopment.18: Uhereye mu gihembwe ca gatatu, umwana yongera ibiro vuba kandi buhorobuhoro yitegura kuvuka.
BabyDevelopment.19: Umuvuduko wo gukura uratandukanye ku mwana ku wundi: ivyo bihe ni ibigereranyo rusangi gusa.
BabyDevelopment.20: Guhera ku byumweru 6: umutima uratangura gutera
BabyDevelopment.21: Hafi y’ibyumweru 20: ukwimuka kwa mbere kuraryumvwa
BabyDevelopment.24: Umwana “yumva vyose” kuva mu ntango: kwumva ntikuvamwo gukura kugeza mu gihembwe ca kabiri
BabyDevelopment.25: Ishusho y’inda yerekana igitsina c’umwana: nta bimenyetso vya siyanse bibishigikira
BabyDevelopment.26: Umwana ukina cane ni we muzima kuruta: ukwimuka kuratandukanye cane ku mwana ku wundi
BabyDevelopment.28: Intambwe zose zo gukura k’umwana zigira umuvuduko warwo; gupimwa n’abaganga buri gihe bifasha kwemeza ko vyose bigenda neza.

BasalTemperature.6: Uburyo bworoshe bwo kwemeza, ivyabaye bimaze kuba, ko ovulation yabaye.
BasalTemperature.8: Impemba y’umubiri (basal body temperature) ni iki?
BasalTemperature.15: Impemba y’umubiri (basal body temperature) ni impemba y’umubiri wawe uri mu kiruhuko cose, mbere yo gukora ikintu cose. Iratandukana gake cane mu gihe c’ukwezi kw’imihango, bitewe na hormone zawe.
BasalTemperature.16: Ipimwa buri gitondo, mbere yo guhaguruka, ku gihe kimwe kandi hamwe n’icipimo c’impemba kimwe.
BasalTemperature.18: Koresha buri gihe icipimo kimwe, vyiza ni icipimo cagenewe impemba y’umubiri (basal) (gifise ukuri kurusha, kugeza ku gice ca dogere).
BasalTemperature.20: Pima ku gihe gihamye, mbere yo guhaguruka, nyuma yo kuryama nibura amasaha 3 ata kubyuka.
BasalTemperature.22: Andika ivyo wapimye ako kanya, mbere y’uko uhaguruka canke uvuga.
BasalTemperature.23: Impemba y’umubiri yiyongera gake (0,2 kugeza kuri 0,5°C) ako kanya nyuma ya ovulation, bitewe na progesterone, ikagumaho hejuru kugeza ku mihango ikurikira.
BasalTemperature.25: Iba hasi mu gice ca mbere c’ukwezi, ikazamuka nyuma ya ovulation ikagumaho — ishusho itagaragara neza atari nyuma y’iminsi myinshi yo gupima.
BasalTemperature.31: Si uburyo bwo guhanura ahubwo ni uburyo bwo kwemeza: bugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ukwezi kwawe, ovulation imaze kuba — si ukuyiteganya.
BasalTemperature.32: Kubukurikirana wenyine mu kwezi kumwe canke kubiri ntibisanzwe bihagije: ishusho iragaragara iyo isubiyemwo.
BasalTemperature.34: Nta zamuka ry’impemba ribonetse mu mezi menshi yuzuye
BasalTemperature.35: Impemba zikomeza kutaba zihamye cane naho wapimye neza
BasalTemperature.36: Ufise ibibazo ku bijanye n’uburumbuke bwawe iki gukurikirana conyine kitashobora gusubiza
BasalTemperature.38: Guhuza impemba y’umubiri na cervical mucus canke ibipimo vya ovulation bitanga ishusho yuzuye kuruta y’ukwezi kwawe.
BasalTemperature.39: Impemba y’umubiri yiyongera gake (0,2 kugeza kuri 0,5°C) ako kanya nyuma ya ovulation, bitewe na progesterone.
BasalTemperature.40: Ipimwa buri gitondo, mbere yo guhaguruka, ku gihe kimwe kandi hamwe n’icipimo kimwe.
BasalTemperature.41: Si uburyo bwo guhanura ahubwo ni uburyo bwo kwemeza: bugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ukwezi kwawe.
BasalTemperature.42: Kubuhuza n’ibindi bimenyetso (cervical mucus, ibipimo vya ovulation) bitanga ishusho yuzuye kuruta.
BasalTemperature.43: Ivyo ni ivyo kumenyesha gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga zikureba wenyine. Niba ufise ugukeka, saba inama umuganga.

BirthControlPills.6: Ukuntu iginika rikora, ukuntu ririnyobwa buri musi, n’ibyiza n’imbibi ryaryo nyamukuru.
BirthControlPills.12: Iginika rifise hormone — estrogene na/canke progestine, bitewe n’ubwoko — zikora cane mu kubuza canke guhagarika ovulation. Rihindura kandi cervical mucus, bigatuma intanga zigora kunyuramwo.
BirthControlPills.14: Hariho ubwoko bwinshi bw’amaginika, harimwo ayuzuye n’afise progestine yonyine. Ibiyagize n’uburyo bwo kuyanywa bishobora gutandukana.
BirthControlPills.15: Kuryanywa buri gihe ni ngombwa. Bitewe n’ubwoko bw’iginika, ivyo gukora nyuma yo kwibagira rimwe biratandukana — ni co gituma ari ngombwa kurondera urupapuro rw’ubuyobozi rw’umuti wawe.
BirthControlPills.16: Hitamwo igihe c’umusi woroshe kwibuka (ifunguro, kuryama...)
BirthControlPills.17: Koresha ikwibutsa canke porogaramu nibiba ngombwa
BirthControlPills.18: Bika urupapuro rw’ubuyobozi hafi nimba ufise ugukeka
BirthControlPills.19: Nk’uko biri ku buryo bwose bwo kudasama, iginika rifise ibyiza ariko kandi n’imbibi zimwezimwe ukwiye kumenya imbere yo kurihitamwo.
BirthControlPills.22: Rigabanya cane ibyago vyo gusama iyo rikoreshejwe neza
BirthControlPills.23: Rishobora gutuma imihango iba ihamye kandi iteganywa
BirthControlPills.24: Rishobora kugabanya ububabare n’imihango ku bantu bamwebamwe
BirthControlPills.25: Rishobora guhindurwa canke gusimburwa niba ridakwiriye
BirthControlPills.28: Rikeneye kunywa buri gihe, bitewe n’ubwoko bw’iginika
BirthControlPills.29: Kwibagira kurinywa birashobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwaryo
BirthControlPills.30: Abantu bamwebamwe bashobora kugira ingaruka mbi
BirthControlPills.31: Ntirikingira indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (STI)
BirthControlPills.33: Iginika ni uburyo bwiza bwa hormone bwo kudasama iyo rikoreshejwe neza. Kuririnywa buri gihe, ingaruka mbi zishoboka, n’uko ridakingira STI ni ibintu vy’ingenzi vyo kumenya.
BirthControlPills.34: Niba utekereza uburyo bwo kudasama canke uburyo ukoresha butakubereye, ntutinye kuvugana n’umuganga, umubyaza canke undi muganga.

BoneHealth.6: Igituma menopause yongera ibyago vya osteoporose, n’uburyo bwo kurinda amagufwa yawe buri musi.
BoneHealth.14: Estrogene ifasha mu buryo busanzwe kurinda ubukomere bw’amagufwa mu gutinda kwiyuburura kwayo. Kugabanuka kwa estrogene muri menopause kwihutisha gutakaza amagufwa, cane cane mu myaka ya mbere nyuma y’uko imihango ihagaze.
BoneHealth.15: Osteopenia ivuga ubukomere bw’amagufwa buri hasi ya bisanzwe, butaragera ku rugero rwa osteoporose. Osteoporose ni ukuvunagurika kw’amagufwa gukomeye kuruta kongera ibyago vyo kuvunika, cane cane iyo wagwiye.
BoneHealth.17: Ayo mazina yompi asobanura gutakaza ubukomere bw’amagufwa, si ugufwa ryamaze kuvunika — ni ikimenyetso co kwirinda, si impamvu yo guhagarika umutima.
BoneHealth.18: Iki gipimo kitababaza gipima ubukomere bw’amabuye y’amagufwa. Gishobora gutangwa bitewe n’imyaka yawe, amateka yawe n’ayo mu muryango, canke ibindi bishobora kuteza ibyago vyamenyekanye hamwe n’umuganga wawe.
BoneHealth.21: Imyitozo ikoresha uburemere bw’umubiri (kugenda n’amaguru, imyitozo y’imbaraga)
BoneHealth.23: Amateka yo mu muryango ya osteoporose
BoneHealth.26: Umubiri woroshe cane canke kudakora imyitozo na gato
BoneHealth.28: Kugira kimwe canke vyinshi muri ivyo ntibivuga ko uzorwara osteoporose — bifasha cane mu gutangura ikiganiro n’umuganga wawe ku bijanye no gupimwa.
BoneHealth.30: Calcium, vitamine D n’imyitozo ikoresha uburemere bw’umubiri biguma ari ingeso zifasha cane buri musi mu kubungabunga imbaraga z’amagufwa mu gihe kirekire.

Breastfeeding.7: Iminsi ya mbere yo konsa ni igihe co kwiga ku mwana no ku mubyeyi. Kwongorera ibere, umuvuduko, uko wicaye no kwitegereza bifasha buhorobuhoro kubona ivyoroshe.
Breastfeeding.16: Konsa gushika buhorobuhoro. Amasaha ya mbere, hanyuma iminsi ya mbere, biha umwana n’umubyeyi igihe co kwiga hamwe.
Breastfeeding.20: Gukorana uruhu ku ruhu n’umwana no kwongorera ibere hakiri kare bishobora gufasha konsa gutangura neza.
Breastfeeding.22: Umwana ashobora konka kenshi. Ni ibisanzwe ko umuvuduko uhinduka.
Breastfeeding.24: Konka bigenda buhorobuhoro biba umuvuduko usangiwe n’umwana n’umubyeyi.
Breastfeeding.26: Amata asohoka agenda ahuza n’ivyo umwana akeneye buhorobuhoro.
Breastfeeding.28: Aho kwitegereza gusa isaha, bishobora gufasha kwitegereza ibimenyetso vy’uko umwana abyutse, konka, n’uko ahumeka ivyo yarize.
Breastfeeding.30: Impinja ishobora gusaba konka kenshi, rimwe na rimwe incuro 8 kugeza kuri 12 mu masaha 24.
Breastfeeding.32: Umwana ashobora kwimuka, gukinguza akanwa, canke kurondera ibere iyo atangiye kwumva inzara.
Breastfeeding.34: Umubare w’ingoma zitose n’izanduye ni kimwe mu bintu vyo kwitegereza buri musi.
Breastfeeding.36: Uko wicaye neza no kwongorera ibere neza birashobora koroshya konsa. Niba ububabare ari bwinshi canke buhoraho, umuganga ashobora gusuzuma uko wicaye n’uko umwana yongoreye ibere.
Breastfeeding.38: Igenzura rityoroshe mu gihe co konsa
Breastfeeding.42: Umwana afatwa hafi y’umubiri, umutwe wiwe ukaba ushinzwe neza.
Breastfeeding.44: Rindira ko akanwa gakinguka bihagije imbere yo kumuha ibere.
Breastfeeding.46: Kwongorera ibere neza ntibikwiye gutera ububabare bukomeye canke buhoraho.
Breastfeeding.48: Ukwonka n’ukumira amata bishobora kuboneka mu gihe co konsa.
Breastfeeding.50: Nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ko ingorane zikomera. Umuganga wize ashobora gufasha gusuzuma uko wicaye, uko umwana yongorera ibere, canke ivyo umwana akeneye.
Breastfeeding.52: Ashobora kugushigikira mu kwongorera ibere kwa mbere.
Breastfeeding.56: Ashobora gufasha iyo kwongorera ibere bigoye.
Breastfeeding.58: Iminsi ya mbere ishobora gutandukana cane. Umuvuduko wo konsa n’ingene amata ari vyinshi bishobora guhinduka buhorobuhoro uko igihe kigenda. Niba hari ikikuraje ishinga, saba inama umuganga.
Breastfeeding.60: Konsa kwa mbere ni igihe co kwiga ku mwana no ku mubyeyi.
Breastfeeding.62: Uko wicaye neza no kwongorera ibere neza ni ngombwa.
Breastfeeding.63: Kwitegereza ibimenyetso vy’umwana bifasha kuruta kwiyemeza gahunda ihamye cane.
Breastfeeding.64: Umubyaza canke umujyanama mu konsa ashobora kugufasha mu ngorane za mbere.
Breastfeeding.65: Ivyo ni ivyo kumenyesha gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga zikureba wenyine.

CervicalMucus.6: Ikimenyetso ca kamere, kitishyurwa, co kubona igihe cawe c’uburumbuke.
CervicalMucus.15: Ni igisohoka c’umubiri gisanzwe gikorwa n’inkondo y’umura. Cervical mucus ihindura uko imeze mu gihe c’ukwezi bitewe na estrogene na progesterone.
CervicalMucus.19: Irarushiriza kuba nyinshi, ikaba y’urujijo kandi ifata.
CervicalMucus.21: Irererana, irambuka kandi ikaba nk’umweru w’igi ritetse.
CervicalMucus.23: Irakomera, ntishobora kurebwamwo, canke iba nkeya cane.
CervicalMucus.30: Itegereze ishusho n’uko imeze ukoresheje impapuro z’umusarani canke intoki zisukuye, hafi ku gihe kimwe c’umusi, maze wandike ivyo ubonye.
CervicalMucus.33: Iginika ryo kudasama canke imiti imwemwe
CervicalMucus.35: Umuntu wese afise uko ameze, kandi kumenya ukwawe bisaba imyitozo mu mezi menshi. Kwitegereza iyi mpinduka buri musi, hamwe n’ibindi bimenyetso, bigufasha kumenya neza igihe cawe c’uburumbuke — ariko ntibisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga niba ufise impungenge.
CervicalMucus.37: Guhuza cervical mucus n’impemba y’umubiri wawe canke ibipimo vya ovulation bitanga ishusho yuzuye kuruta y’ukwezi kwawe.
CervicalMucus.38: Cervical mucus ihindura uko imeze mu gihe c’ukwezi bitewe na estrogene na progesterone.
CervicalMucus.39: Ovulation yegereje, iba irerana, irambuka kandi ikaba nk’umweru w’igi ritetse.
CervicalMucus.40: Kwitegereza iyi mpinduka buri musi, hamwe n’ibindi bimenyetso, bigufasha kumenya neza igihe cawe c’uburumbuke.
CervicalMucus.41: Kumenya uko ukwawe kumera bisaba imyitozo n’amezi menshi yo kwitegereza.
CervicalMucus.42: Ivyo ni ivyo kumenyesha gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga zikureba wenyine. Niba ufise ugukeka, saba inama umuganga.

ChildbirthPrep.6: Inkingi zitatu zo kwegera umusi ukomeye wizeye kuruta.
ChildbirthPrep.15: Isakoshi y’ibitaro yiteguye mu kwezi ka 8
ChildbirthPrep.16: Amasomo yo kwitegura kubyara agufasha gusobanukirwa intambwe zo kubyara n’uburyo bwo guhumeka buzagufasha kuri wa musi ukomeye.
ChildbirthPrep.17: Gutegura isakoshi y’ibitaro mu kwezi ka 8 bigukiza guhagarika umutima mu minota ya nyuma. Ubusanzwe irimwo:
ChildbirthPrep.20: Ibikoresho vy’isuku n’ibitambaro vyo nyuma yo kubyara
ChildbirthPrep.22: Ivyo wifuza ku bijanye no gucunga ububabare
ChildbirthPrep.23: Abo wifuza ko bamwe baba bahari igihe cyo kubyara
ChildbirthPrep.24: Ivyo witeze ku bijanye no gukorana uruhu ku ruhu n’umwana
ChildbirthPrep.25: Gahunda yoroshe yo kubyara igufasha kumenyesha ivyo wifuza itsinda ry’abaganga, ukaguma kandi witeguye guhinduka: uko ibintu bigenda vyose bishobora guhinduka bitewe n’ibihe.
ChildbirthPrep.27: Kwitegura ntibivuga kugenzura vyose: ni ukwiha uburyo bwo kwegera umusi ukomeye wizeye kuruta kandi udafise ugukeka kwinshi.

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Ibibazo bikwiye kwibaza kugira ubone uburyo bwo kudasama bubereye ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi, ivyo ukeneye n’imigambi yawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Nta buryo bumwe buhebuje bwo kudasama bubereye bose. Imbere yo guhitamwo uburyo, bishobora gufasha gutekereza ku ngeso zawe, ivyo ukunda, ivyo umubiri wawe wihanganira n’imigambi yawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.15: Nkeneye igikorwa cya buri musi canke cya buri cyumweru, canke igisubizo kimara igihe kirekire?
ChooseHormonalMethod.16: Mfise umugambi wo gusama mu gihe gito kiri imbere?
ChooseHormonalMethod.17: Ingengo y’imari yanje ni iyihe, kandi ubu buryo bwo kudasama bworoshe kubona?
ChooseHormonalMethod.18: Abantu babiri bashobora guhitamwo uburyo butandukanye, bombi bakaba bahisemwo ivyabereye ibihe vyabo. Ihitamwo ryiza riterwa cane n’uko ushaka gukoresha uburyo bwawe bwo kudasama n’ivyo ushaka.
ChooseHormonalMethod.20: Uburyo bugaragara neza ku mpapuro si ko buri bwo bworoshe canke bukorohera kuruta buri musi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.21: Kugira ngo ugereranye uburyo bwinshi, ushobora kurebera ku bipimo bitandukanye. Intego si ukumenya vyose mu mutwe, ahubwo ni ukumenya ivyo vy’ukuri bikugize.
ChooseHormonalMethod.23: Uburyo bumwebumwe busaba igikorwa cya buri musi, ubundi bugasaba kwitwararika rimwe mu cyumweru, canke kenshi kudasanzwe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.25: Ingaruka wumva zishobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi. Ni ngombwa kwitegereza uko umubiri wawe wakira no kubivuga niba hari ikibabaje.
ChooseHormonalMethod.27: Niba wiringiye gusama vuba, igihe cokoreshejwe n’ukugaruka kw’uburumbuke nyuma yo guhagarika bishobora kuba mu bikwiye kuganirwako.
ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Ubushobozi ntiburi mu buryo bwahisemwo gusa, ahubwo no mu kubukoresha neza kandi buri gihe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Itandukaniro rikomeye hagati y’uburyo ni ingene ukeneye gutekereza ku buryo bwawe bwo kudasama.
ChooseHormonalMethod.43: Uburyo bwa hormone bushobora kumvikana mu buryo butandukanye ku muntu ku wundi. Bamwe babona impinduka mu kwezi kwabo, mu mihango, canke izindi ngaruka mbi. Ivyo ntibivuga mu buryo bwikora ko uburyo butakubereye, ariko bikwiye kwitonderwa.
ChooseHormonalMethod.45: Niba ingaruka ari nyinshi, ihoraho canke idasanzwe, ntugume wenyine n’ibibazo vyawe. Umuganga, umubyaza canke undi muganga ashobora kugufasha kumenya niba ukwiye gukomeza, guhindura canke gusimbura uburyo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Imigambi yawe yo gusama ishobora kandi kugira ingaruka ku guhitamwo kwawe. Niba ushaka kudasama imyaka myinshi, uburyo bumara igihe kirekire bukwiye gutekerezwako. Niba utekereza gusama vuba, ubundi buryo bushobora kuba bwiza ku gihe cawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Kuvuga ku migambi yawe yo gusama, naho yaba ikiri kure canke itazwi, bifasha umuganga kuyobora neza ikiganiro.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Kubonana n’umuganga bigufasha gupima ibyiza, ingorane n’ibibuza bishoboka bya buri buryo. Ushobora gutegura ibibazo bike imbere kugira ntiwibagire ikintu c’ingenzi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.52: Ibyiza vy’ubu buryo kuri jewe ni ibihe?
ChooseHormonalMethod.53: Ni izihe ngaruka mbi nshobora kugira?
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: Nogira nte iyo mbwibagiwe, iyo buva mu mwanya wabwo, canke iyo mbwifuje guhagarika?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Ubu buryo buhuye n’imigambi yanje yo gusama?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Umubyaza canke umuganga ashobora gutekereza ku mateka yawe y’ubuzima, imiti, ivyo ukunda n’uko ubaho imbere yo kukugira inama y’uburyo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Hitamwo uburyo buhuye n’ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.61: Tekereza ku buryo umubiri wawe wihanganira n’ivyo ukunda.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Tekereza ku migambi yawe yo gusama no ku gihe cawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.63: Saba umuganga inama niba ufise ugukeka.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Uburyo bwiza si ko buri bwo busa n’ubworoshe cane canke bukunzwe cane. Ni ubwo bubereye ibihe vyawe, ivyo ukeneye n’ivyo ukunda, nyuma y’ikiganiro cumvikana n’umuganga.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Iyi nkuru ni iyo kumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga zikureba wenyine.

ConceptionLifestyle.1:
Ingeso zo mu buzima
n’urugendo rwawe rwo gusama
ConceptionLifestyle.6: Ingeso zoroshe zishobora gushigikira urugendo rwawe — nta gitutu.
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Ingeso zimwezimwe zoroshe zo mu buzima zishobora gushigikira urugendo rwo gusama, naho zitashobora kwemeza ivyo uzoronka zonyine.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Guhagarika umutima buri gihe bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buringanire bwa hormone no, ku bagore bamwebamwe, ku kuringaniza ukwezi. Kwiha ibihe vyo gutuza ni kimwe mu bigize urugendo.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Kwifuza “gukora vyose neza” bishobora na ko kuba isoko yo guhagarika umutima: gushaka ingeso zisanzwe ari nziza birahagije, nta kwiyemeza kudakwiye.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Itabi, rishobora kugira ingaruka ku buryumbuke bw’abashakanye bombi
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Imyitozo ya siporo ikomeye kandi ihoraho, ishobora ku rundi ruhande gutinda uburumbuke
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Isukari nyinshi isukuye, ishobora guhungabanya uburinganire bwa hormone
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Ingeso ziringaniye muri rusangi, zitarimwo ukurengera canke ukwiyemeza kudakwiye, ni zo zifasha cane buri musi.
ConceptionLifestyle.26: Ingeso zo mu buzima n’urugendo rwo gusama — AWA

ConceptionStart.6: Ibimenyetso vy’ingenzi vyo gutangura urugendo rwawe rwo gusama wizeye.
ConceptionStart.12: Intambwe ya mbere ifasha cane ni ukumenya igihe cawe c’uburumbuke ukoresheje ukwezi kwawe: uburebure bw’ukwezi, ibimenyetso vy’umubiri, na, nimba ubishaka, ibikoresho vyo gukurikirana nk’ibipimo vya ovulation canke impemba y’umubiri.
ConceptionStart.13: Kugira imibonano mpuzabitsina buri gihe, buri minsi 2 kugeza kuri 3, bipfukirana mu buryo busanzwe igihe cawe cirumbuka cane nta gutegura gukomeye.
ConceptionStart.14: Nta mpamvu yo kwiyoroheza ku musi wa ovulation gusa
ConceptionStart.15: Umuvuduko uhamye woroshe kuwugumana kuruta gutegura gukomeye
ConceptionStart.16: Ubuzima bwiza bw’abashakanye ni ngombwa na bwo muri iki gihe
ConceptionStart.17: Abashakanye benshi basama mu mezi 12 nyuma yo guhagarika uburyo bwo kudasama. Iki gihe kiratandukana bitewe n’ibintu vyinshi bijanye n’ibihe bya buri wese.
ConceptionStart.19: Irenze amezi 12 (canke amezi 6 nyuma y’imyaka 35), ni vyiza kubonana n’umuganga kugira agusuzume, naho bitavuga ko hariho ikibazo.
ConceptionStart.21: Kumenya ukwezi kwawe, kugumana umuvuduko usanzwe no kwihangana ni inkingi zitatu zo gutangura uru rugendo utuje.
